US House prioritizes funding bill to avert government shutdown

The U.S. House of Representatives returned to Washington with the primary goal of passing a funding bill to prevent a government shutdown. Leaders aimed to quickly approve a measure, with a vote expected on a Senate bill designed to avert the shutdown. The House had been away for five weeks, and avoiding a shutdown was the top priority upon their return.
